src: MRO HiRISE 25cm orthomosaic (NASA/JPL/UArizona, via NASA Mars Trek), zoom-15 tiles ~1.3 m/px; ripples = oriented 5-30 m texture (structure-tensor coherence x band energy), rocks = shadow next to a sunlit face (sun from the west). Covers 77.355-77.481E, 18.386-18.501N; elsewhere not counted. Walking factors ripple x1.3, rocky x1.15 are working assumptions.
